readme:
# TikTok Stream Room Information API

Retrieve stream room details directly from a TikTok broadcast URL. Pass the target link via `live_room_url` to inspect stream data, including offline rooms.

## Use cases

- Retrieve stream room details using a TikTok link.
- Check offline stream room information.
- Inspect broadcast room metadata for creator tracking.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/tiktok/web/live-data" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"live_room_url": "https://www.tiktok.com/@.caseoh_daily/live"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `live_room_url` | string | Yes | Live room link |

## Notes

- Can return details for stream rooms that are currently offline.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.
